author: Chris Ogden
releaseNotes:
1.4.15 - When SignalBricks no longer accepts the hub's connection, the app replaces its access token; connect again from the app.
1.4.14 - Unchanged codes are no longer rewritten on locks whose driver reports them as numbers. After updating, delete by hand any slot the Bookings page says names two bookings.
1.4.13 - Code names a driver shows in lower case are handled correctly, with a warning when a lock drops a code's leading zeros. After updating, delete by hand any copies of booking codes the Bookings page lists.
1.4.12 - Stricter confirmation of code writes.
1.4.11 - Locks whose driver encrypts its code list are now read; a lock that can't be read is shown on the app page.
1.4.10 - Waits for a lock's code list before adding new codes to it.
1.4.9 - New optional Previous prefix for code name setting, so codes stay managed after a prefix change.
1.4.8 - Reconnect fixes.
1.4.7 - Hub report fixes.
1.4.6 - Announces the app's version and slot settings for SignalBricks Telemetry's daily hub report.
1.4.5 - Reconnect follow-ups.
1.4.4 - One-click Reconnect with a 10-minute sign-in link.
1.4.3 - Clearer confirmation page after Connect or Reconnect.
1.4.2 - Error messages and logs never contain door codes.
1.4.1 - Clearer Connection status and Bookings page; door codes and tokens are no longer logged.
1.4.0 - Connect to SignalBricks with OAuth instead of copying URLs and tokens.
1.3.7 - New Bookings page, with codes masked.
1.3.6 - Fixes the update from 1.3.4 failing while the hub saves the code.
1.3.5 - Door code refresh is off by default and reads one lock at a time. After updating, click Done once to remove the old midnight refresh.
1.3.4 - First release through Hubitat Package Manager; the app page shows the name with the version. Hubs that installed the app by hand: use HPM Match Up, don't Install it again.
